newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar futures revive late to close up.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar futures revive late to close up.

text.p: White sugar futures moved into positive territory in late trading to show modest gains having treaded water most of Thursday.
However there was no impetus from New York to lift London out of its recent lethargy, traders said.

A lacklustre performance on the raws market ensured that premium movements were limited, deterring sellers waiting at $69 and above on the May arbitrage and leaving London's nearby spreads trapped in a range.
May and August attracted most dealing interest as usual but prices mostly hovered around their opening levels throughout the day.
At the close May was up 90 cents at $308.00 and August up 30 cents at $306.00. Volume reached 684 lots and 252 lots respectively on the dominant two months.
Movements in Paris were similarly meagre. May was 50 cents ahead at $307.30 and August down 50 cents at $305.30.
